svg.aria-label: Phone layout: the key bar rides above the keyboard and the layout follows the visual viewport.
svg.title: Phone layout: the key bar rides above the keyboard and the layout follows the visual viewport.

g.text: Designed with a thumb in mind
Key bar rides above the keyboard
Tab, undo, cursor keys, find, symbols and more.
Nothing hides behind the on screen keyboard on iOS or Android.
Bottom sheets replace tiny menus. A file drawer slides in.
Notches and home bars never cover controls.
Auto save, even in the background
Edits are written when the app is hidden.
